text: The physical exam is unremarkable, and the bilirubin levels are consistent with benign physiological jaundice. Given the baby's age, feeding patterns, and normal lab results, this appears to be a standard case of newborn jaundice. DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological Jaundice
